title: plead inbox absence entry (schema v1)
description: One JSON file dropped into watch.inbox.paths.root. The file describes a scheduled auto-reply/forwarding or cancels an active absence. Unknown properties are ignored for forward compatibility.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Omit (or null) for version 1.

action.description: schedule creates or replaces an absence; cancel disables the reply and removes the deputy forwarding immediately.

email.description: Target mailbox. Wins over samAccountName; null is treated as absent.

samAccountName.description: AD account name (null treated as absent). Resolved through ad-account-map.json when present, otherwise through domain or watch.inbox.domain.

domain.description: Mail domain for samAccountName (null treated as absent). Required when neither ad-account-map.json nor watch.inbox.domain provides the address.

startDate.description: First day of the absence (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for schedule.

startTime.description: Start time (HH:mm or HH:mm:ss); null treated as absent. Defaults to 00:00:00.

endDate.description: Last day of the absence (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for schedule.

endTime.description: End time (HH:mm or HH:mm:ss); null treated as absent. Defaults to 23:59:59.

deputyEmail.description: Optional deputy (null treated as absent). Presence switches to forwarding mode; must differ from the target mailbox.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for naive date/time values (null treated as absent). Defaults to watch.inbox.timezone, then the process TZ.

language.description: Render language, e.g. de or en (null treated as absent). Defaults to watch.inbox.language or template.language.

subject.description: Reply subject (null treated as absent). Empty or omitted uses Plesk's default Re: <request_subject>.

format.description: Reply content type (null treated as absent). Omit to infer from the rendered message.

inclusive.description: Template wording: true means through endDate, false means until endDate (null treated as absent). Defaults to watch.inbox.inclusive.

data.description: Arbitrary template variables merged over watch.inbox.data_file. Values are scalars or locale maps.

submittedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp (null treated as absent; audit/ordering only).
